sources.name: CoinGecko API
sources.use: market-cap/volume snapshot (coins/markets), coin-to-contract mapping (coins/list?include_platform=true), per-coin metadata and images

sources.name: Trust Wallet assets
sources.use: per-address info.json (status, decimals, symbol) and preferred logo.png, pinned commit

sources.name: Uniswap default token list
sources.use: independent address/decimals cross-check (Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Arbitrum One, Base)

sources.name: Jupiter verified token list
sources.use: independent cross-check, holder counts and liquidity (Solana)

sources.name: Blockscout / GeckoTerminal
sources.use: holder counts used only as a selection filter (not stored in the registry)

sources.name: Public RPC
sources.url: https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, https://bsc-rpc.publicnode.com, https://arbitrum-one-rpc.publicnode.com, https://base-rpc.publicnode.com, https://api.trongrid.io, https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com
sources.use: on-chain decimals, symbol, total supply, Solana mint owner program and Metaplex/Token-2022 metadata

selection: Hot tokens per network by estimated on-network value (lower of CoinGecko market cap and on-chain supply x price) in a 2026-09-21 snapshot, after activity filters (24h volume, holder counts) and exclusions (tokenized stocks/funds, vault/receipt tokens, superseded, deprecated or sanctioned tokens). Each address is cross-checked against CoinGecko plus at least one independent list, and decimals are verified on-chain. A listing only lets the app display a name, symbol, decimals and icon offline; it is not an endorsement, safety rating or live ranking.

coinmarketcap.note: Listing membership and names/symbols/logos only. Decimals are never taken from here; see cmc-onchain.json.
